arStrings.szText: "It was good to meet you, Bnatros. Tell me, where will you all travel next?"
I feel the same, my friend! As for where to next…I’d say the Temple of Life. Adoné said it was a sight to see.
Pronunciation: Ah-doh-neh            -- Bnatros is friendly here, glad to have met the Player. Hopeful for the future.
When things are darkest, it is good to find the beauty in the world. Perhaps we will inspire other Askari to join us on the way. Light willing…
